node: AI-server high-end passives and board-level power delivery
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-tradable universe for AI-server high-end passives and board-level power delivery. The reference lane is Murata, because official materials and recent reporting directly connect AI-server demand to capacitors, server power modules, and MLCC capacity tightness. The underfollowed lane favors US-listed or US-traded component suppliers one or two steps away from GPUs: Vicor for high-current AI accelerator power modules, Vishay for broad passive/discrete exposure including capacitors and inductors, and Bel Fuse for board-mount/front-end power, magnetics, connectors, and protection products. Evidence strength is uneven: Vicor and Murata have direct AI/server power language; Vishay has broad AI-related power and passive-component evidence but needs product-level AI-server confirmation; Bel Fuse is a plausible second-order candidate but currently needs explicit AI-server or hyperscaler customer evidence.
